name_reason: Name is fully compliant with the data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention and accurately reflects both purpose and data type. 'tile_attribute_flags_buffer' describes the contents (per-tile-sprite attribute/flag records loaded from FDSHAP.DAT) and 'ptr' marks the data type (a uint32 base-pointer slot in BSS). No Ghidra address residue. Confirmed by readers (fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos, fd2_composite_battle_tile_map) that index it as ptr + tile_id*4 and by writers that assign it the return of fd2_load_dat_resource('FDSHAP.DAT', scene_id*2+1).
purpose: Base pointer to the battle tile-attribute buffer (an array of 4-byte attribute-flag records, one per tile-sheet sprite), loaded from FDSHAP.DAT resource scene_id*2+1.
logic_summary: Holds the heap address returned by fd2_load_dat_resource('FDSHAP.DAT', scene_id*2+1). Readers index it as ptr[tile_id*4] where tile_id is the 10-bit (0..0x3FF) sprite index extracted from the battle tile-map meta word; each record's byte 0 carries the tile animation/flag bits (0x04/0x08 = swap-every-frame tile-id advance, 0x10 = chapter-palette half-step; 0x60 event class, 0x80 renderable also reside in the 4-byte record). The compositor (fd2_composite_battle_tile_map) and the per-tile query accessor (fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos), plus AI / menu / cursor tile-property lookups, all read through this pointer. It is rebuilt (free-then-load) on each chapter init / new-game / continue / load path; writers: fd2_load_chapter_battle_data (0x1096f), fd2_load_save_and_init_engine (0x1026b), fd2_chapter_23_end (0x24a87).
datatype: uint32 (4-byte base-pointer slot in .object2 / BSS; address-as-integer pointer to a heap buffer of 4-byte tile-attribute records)
element_semantics: Pointed-to buffer = array of 4-byte tile-attribute records indexed by 10-bit tile sprite id (ptr[tile_id*4]). Record byte 0 holds animation/flag bits read by the tile compositor and tile-query accessors: 0x04 / 0x08 swap-every-frame tile-id advance, 0x10 chapter-palette half-step; the 4-byte record also encodes 0x60 event-class and 0x80 renderable bits.
comment_original_issue: Existing comment block (main.c:1030-1035) correctly identified the buffer source (FDSHAP.DAT scene_id*2+1), the slot type (uint32 BSS zero-init), and the base-pointer role, but omitted the pointed-to buffer's structure (array of 4-byte attribute records indexed by tile_id), the flag-bit semantics, the readers/writers, and the free-then-load reload behavior that neighboring pointer-slot comments (e.g. data_fd2_vga_palette_data_ptr) document.
